query:
SELECT v.id
           FROM (SELECT id, config FROM saved_view
                 WHERE user_id = ANY($1) AND config->>'kind' = 'crm-list' OFFSET 0) v
           WHERE v.config->>'teamId' = $2::uuid::text
             AND jsonb_typeof(v.config->'companyIds') = 'array'
             AND v.config->'companyIds' ?| $3
           ORDER BY v.id
